hooks.name: Queue saved files for review
hooks.description: Append each file the agent saves to a queue the editor opens with :KiroChanged.

hooks.name: Queue created files for review
hooks.description: Append each file the agent creates to the same review queue.

hooks.name: Open changed files when the turn ends
hooks.description: At end of turn, if the review queue is non-empty, launch the editor on the changed files. The launcher runs :KiroChanged, which opens and clears the queue.
